title: Baby Ken in High Chair, 1958 Vintage Black & White Kitchen Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from June 15, 1958, capturing a baby named Ken sitting in a vinyl and metal high chair in a mid-century home kitchen. He has his hand near his mouth with a teether resting on the high chair tray. The background details classic 1950s domestic interior decor, including kitchen curtains printed with cooking utensils, pattern wallpaper, linoleum flooring, and a chrome-rimmed Formica dining table.
